faqs.question: How do I place an order on DeepAura?
faqs.answer: Browse our festive collection, select your desired products and quantities, click "Add to Cart", and proceed to checkout.

faqs.question: What are your delivery timelines for Diwali?
faqs.answer: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours of placement. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days across major Indian metros.

faqs.question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer Cash on Delivery for all serviceable PIN codes across India on orders up to ₹5,000.

faqs.question: How do I apply a discount coupon?
faqs.answer: In your Cart Drawer or at the Checkout page, enter your promotional coupon code (e.g. DIWALI15) in the "Discount Code" field and click Apply.

faqs.question: What is your return and replacement policy?
faqs.answer: If any festive decor item arrives broken or defective due to transit, simply notify our customer support team within 48 hours for a free replacement.
